feeds.title: Textbook & Academic Authors Association
feeds.description: The Textbook & Academic Authors Association provides professional development resources, events, and networking opportunities for textbook authors and authors of scholarly journal articles and books. Established in 1987 by math author Mike Keedy, TAA is the only national, nonprofit membership association dedicated solely to assisting textbook and academic authors.

feeds.title: The Thesis Whisperer
feeds.description: The Thesis Whisperer blog is dedicated to the topic of doing a Ph.D. and being an academic in the neo-liberal precarious academy that we (kinda) love. Since 2006 I have worked exclusively with Ph.D. students and early career academics. I help people finish complex research projects with (sometimes very) demanding stakeholders. I'm passionate about helping people reach their potential as researchers and helping to create a kinder, more inclusive academy. I strive to create spaces where people can do their best work and advance human knowledge for the good of all.

feeds.title: Athene Donald's Blog
feeds.description: Hii! I am Athene Donald. I am a professor of physics in the Cavendish Laboratory at the University of Cambridge working on soft matter and biological physics. This blog covers Reflections on working at the physics/biology interface, being a senior woman scientist, and anything else I feel strongly about.

feeds.title: Enago Academy
feeds.description: Enago is a trusted name in author services for the global research community. Since 2005, we have worked with researchers in more than 125 countries, improving the communication of their research and helping them achieve a successful publication. Enago Academy provides ESL researchers with comprehensive knowledge resources to achieve their publication goals and enhance their research careers.

feeds.title: WeAreTeachers
feeds.description: We Are Teachers is an online community of educators, numbering over 3 million, dedicated to sharing resources, ideas, and experiences to enhance teaching practices across the United States. It serves as a platform for teachers to advocate for better pay and working conditions, share educational materials, and promote inclusive and diverse teaching approaches. The site strongly emphasizes the importance of educators in shaping the future through their roles and challenges the notion of teaching as merely a job, advocating for it to be seen as a critical and highly skilled profession.

feeds.title: eSchool News
feeds.description: eSchool News connects you to the latest on how today's K-12 educators are using technology in the classroom. It is your daily source for technology news and innovation in education.

feeds.title: MiddleWeb
feeds.description: MiddleWeb is all about middle school and the middle grades, with a sharp focus on teaching and learning in grades 4-8. Articles include book reviews, middle grades mindset, student behavior, pandemic learning, and media literacy.

feeds.title: Thoughtful Minds Blog
feeds.description: Thoughtful Minds is an assignment help agency, featuring dissertation writing, thesis, journals, research paper, essay writing, and online homework help.

feeds.title: TeachThought
feeds.description: TeachThought is an educational platform founded in 2012 that focuses on innovation in K-12 education. It aims to foster innovative teaching through thought leadership, professional development, resource curation, and curriculum development. The platform collaborates globally to support educators and improve learning outcomes, offering content like blog posts, eBooks, podcasts, and online courses. TeachThought also works on developing 21st-century curricula and educational tools through various partnerships.

feeds.title: Kibin - Create Better Writers Blog
feeds.description: Become a better, more confident writer with practical writing advice from Kibin's essay experts. Get tips, strategies, and resources to guide you through every stage of the writing process.

feeds.title: Doctoral Writing
feeds.description: DoctoralWriting is a forum where people who are interested in doctoral writing can come together to share information, resources, ideas, dreams in a spirit of building knowledge and skills around higher degree research writing.

feeds.title: Happy Academic
feeds.description: This is a blog for early and mid-career researchers (EMCRs). This blog accompanies a complete career development program that I am creating for EMCRs.

feeds.title: 360 Assignments
feeds.description: The name every mind thinks of when it comes to academic writing is no other than 360 Assignments. We are a team of educated and experienced academic writers who are ready to provide assignment writing service, every time, anytime.

feeds.title: Tress Academic Blog
feeds.description: Guidelines, checklists, worksheets, and a lot of hands-on advice for Ph.D. students, Postdocs, Researchers, and everybody interested in boosting their performance in academia. Tress Academic teaches key academic competencies to improve the performance of researchers at universities and institutes.

feeds.title: Academic Transformations
feeds.description: Classroom Management Trainer, Learning Coach, and student Advocate location in Reno, Nevada serving clients nation wide. Academic Transformations believes each child has vast academic potential. We provide students with a Learning Coach and Education Advocacy, as well as Classroom Management School Training for school Staff and Administrators.

feeds.title: Dan Cohen Blog
feeds.description: Dan Cohen is the Vice Provost, Dean, and Professor at Northeastern University. His work has focused on the impact of digital media and technology on all aspects of knowledge and learning, from the nature of libraries and their evolving resources to twenty-first-century research techniques and software tools to the changing landscape of communication and publication.

feeds.title: Academic English UK Blog
feeds.description: The blog by Academic English UK. It is an academic blog for worksheets, lessons and advice on reading, writing, listening and speaking skills.

feeds.title: Inside Higher Ed
feeds.description: Inside Higher Ed is a comprehensive resource offering the latest news, analysis, and solutions relevant to the higher education community. Owned by Times Higher Education, it provides authoritative insights and services that aim to empower individuals and organizations within academia. The platform is known for its independent voice and thoughtful analysis, attracting over two million monthly readers. It also offers specialized editorial and marketing solutions tailored to meet the needs of various stakeholders in the education sector.

feeds.title: Zondervan Academic Blog
feeds.description: Together, we produce academic works in various areas of biblical-theological studies that exhibit faithfulness to historic Christian faith, cultural relevance, and excellence.
